services.name: Queen's Brunch Aboard the Dora Queen Sept. 6th
services.desc: It’s a day to appreciate all Dads. Give the dads in your life the gift of great memories and a little relaxation aboard the majestic Dora Queen on our special Father’s Day cruise. We will depart the dock at 12:30 PM on Sunday, June 21st, 2026 for this 2-hour cruise on scenic Lake Dora. Guests may begin boarding at 12:00 PM. Enjoy excellent live music by Dale New on our open-air (under roof) upper deck, or take in the beautiful lake views through the picture windows on our indoor, climate-controlled lower deck, all while sipping your favorite cocktails. Our full-service beverage bar will be available for onboard beverage purchases; Cash and cards are accepted for beverage purchases. Guests
